package: ROUND-2 REPAIR reader-em (cux-r2-em): the refutation's round-2 findings on the office E/M reading - L2/F07 and L2/F08 (P1 rule 8, the explicit statement that no separate office E/M service is documented) and L7/L7-06 (a member's new or established status ignored by the office E/M service's uncertainty)
summary: Hold-only for rule 8, declared BEFORE any code. F07: cues.EM_ABSENCE reads a sentence as an E/M absence statement only when the sentence is that statement and nothing else - a negator governing the visit noun through visit qualifiers only, 'no record/documentation/evidence/mention/note of' the visit noun, or the visit noun (no definite article) 'was/is not (separately) documented|provided|performed|rendered|furnished|done' - with only an optional 'There is/was' opener, the arm's own predicate and day adjuncts (today, on/for this date, on the date of service, for/at/during this encounter, a numeric date, separately) before the sentence ends. Anything else in the sentence - a location hedge ('here', 'in this report', 'elsewhere', 'see the clinic note'), another clause, a condition, a question, a possessive or another head noun the negator governs ('No medication changes at today's office visit were documented') - leaves it no absence statement, and the visit reads exactly as installed 41e03656df61 reads it (it asks). F08: where an absence statement negates a visit mention, routing (detect._route) also holds it when the note states an evaluation of the patient, a history, an examination or a visit in any wording routing reads as no E/M mention (new cues.EM_EVALUATION_STATED, read only to hold), as the existing rule holds it beside another E/M statement read performed or open. L7-06: services._em_service's uncertainty reads new or established status from the encounter context as it already reads the setting (the document's value or a member's; a conflict has none), so a member's answer closes the service-scope question after the one re-assessment instead of asking it again. F09 ('No office evaluation and management service was billed separately.') was judged BY_DESIGN and keeps its head reading (negated).
standard: Round-4 (ruling 2026-11-03 (g); R8 section 4): a releasing rule keeps every must-stay-held input held; closed lists only add holds. Rule 8 is the only releasing rule touched, and it is narrowed (F07) and given one more hold (F08): no input may move toward READY, toward excluded, or toward fewer questions, except the declared L7-06 state (a member's answered status). L7-06 moves no status and no code: it removes one question a member has already answered with a routine context value (directive section 4: 'Ask each material question once and preserve the saved answer'; session decisions (e) and (f): new or established status is member-provided context answered with choices).

findings.L2/F07: major, REGRESSION: 'The office visit is not documented here; it is documented in the clinic note of today.' and 'No medication changes at today's office visit were documented.' read as E/M absence: no E/M question, the visit code EXCLUDED. Repaired by R8b-1.
findings.L2/F08: major, REGRESSION: a same-day evaluation stated in any wording other than an EM_VISIT phrase never contradicted the absence statement (J1 'She was also evaluated today for new-onset jaundice, a separate problem, with a history and examination.' and J2 'Separately, she was seen and examined today ...' beside Mara's sentence: negated, 99213 EXCLUDED). Repaired by R8b-2.
findings.L7/L7-06: major: a member's saved patient_status was ignored by the office E/M uncertainty (services.py near 4481): asked again after the re-assessment, or moved to a new service row. Repaired by E7.
findings.L2/F09: minor, BY_DESIGN (verifier): 'No office evaluation and management service was billed separately.' reads negated through arm 1 as the design says, and on the installed release its twins without 'office' already read negated. Not changed; pinned as it is.

rules.R8b-1: cues.EM_ABSENCE (one pattern, read by detect._em_absent and by services' em_absent sentences as before) matches only from a sentence start - a line start, or a full stop, question or exclamation mark and at most three spaces or tabs - to the sentence's end (a full stop or exclamation mark, a line end, or the end of the window read), and the sentence holds nothing but: an optional 'There is|was|were|has been|had been' opener; then (A) 'no|without|neither' + only visit qualifiers + the visit noun (coordinated visit nouns allowed) + optionally 'is|was|were|are|has been|have been|had been (separately) documented|provided|performed|rendered|furnished|reported|billed|done' (two coordinated verbs allowed) or 'occurred|took place|happened'; or (B) 'no record|documentation|evidence|mention|note(s) of' + qualifiers + the visit noun(s) + optionally '... documented|provided|present|available|found|recorded|included' or 'exist(s)'; or (C) only qualifiers (never 'the' or 'this') + the visit noun(s) + 'was|is|were|are|has been|have been|had been not' or 'wasn't|isn't|weren't|aren't' + '(separately) documented|provided|performed|rendered|furnished|done'; then only day adjuncts: 'today', 'this date', 'on this|the date|day (of service|of the procedure|of the encounter)', 'for this|the date|day|encounter (of service)', 'for today', 'during|at this|the encounter', 'on|for|dated' + a numeric date, 'separately'. The visit qualifiers and nouns are P1's, unchanged. detect._em_absent keeps its date test (every date in the sentence is the service date) and its rule that the visit mention lies inside the statement. Every arm only narrows what P1's pattern matched: no sentence matches now that did not match at c47d71a3.
rules.R8b-2: detect._route: when a visit mention reads negated by an absence statement (EM_ABSENT_CUE) and no other E/M reading is performed or open (the existing EM_ABSENT_CONTRADICTED rule, unchanged), the absence statement is still held - uncertain, a doubt, cue EM_ABSENT_EVALUATION with the evaluation words quoted - when cues.EM_EVALUATION_STATED matches anywhere in the text outside every absence statement: the patient as the one seen/evaluated/examined/assessed/interviewed (she, he, the patient, pt, a titled name; or a capitalised name with evaluated/examined/interviewed) with was|were|is|are|has been|have been|had been|got and at most three adverbs between; an evaluation stated today ('... was seen today'); the clinician as the one evaluating ('I examined', 'we evaluated', 'saw her', 'examined the patient'); seen/evaluated/examined/assessed (today) in (the) clinic|office, never after 'be' (a future visit is no evaluation today); a history, history and physical, history and examination, H&P, evaluation, assessment, consultation or consult performed|obtained|taken|done|completed|conducted|carried out|elicited|held|provided|undertaken|documented; 'physical exam(ination)'; HPI, history of present illness, review of systems, ROS; a clinic/office/visit/consult(ation)/E/M/H&P note. No tense, section, cue or date exempts a match except the future form named (fail closed). The inventory follows routing (services._em_service applies its absence cue only where routing reads the visit negated by that statement), so the two readers agree.
rules.E7: services._em_service: the office E/M service's uncertainty leaves out patient_status when the encounter context gives it a value (origin document or user; a conflict or a missing fact has none), exactly as it already leaves out setting (_setting(context_facts)). em_basis is never context (a member never supplies a clinical fact) and is unchanged.
